clips.title: The story
paras: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull commands the Horde's northern border defense. A seasoned orc commander, he coordinates efforts to repel night elf forces contesting the border near Warsong Gulch.

At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull guards the Horde's foothold at the edge of Ashenvale. He works beside fellow officers such as Kadrak against night elf sentinels and Silverwing forces seeking to reclaim the borderlands. The struggle over Ashenvale's timber and ancient lands keeps the Barrens frontier under constant threat.
